text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Jardiance are urinary tract infections and genital yeast infections, while rare and serious risks include severe dehydration and diabetic ketoacidosis.
snippet_highlighted_words: urinary tract infections and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): You may feel a burning pain when you pee, or notice cloudy urine.
Genital yeast infections: Women and men can get itching, redness, swelling, or unusual discharge.
Increased urination: Your body removes extra sugar through your urine, making you go to the bathroom more often.
Thirst: Losing more fluids through urination can make you feel thirsty.
Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood with nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and trouble breathing—even if your blood sugar is not high.
Severe dehydration: A large loss of body fluids that can cause dizziness, fainting, or sudden kidney problems.
Fournier’s gangrene: A rare, severe bacterial infection of the tissue around the genitals that causes intense pain, swelling, and fever.
Serious allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, or throat, and trouble breathing.
